previous_class: Arbitrary disjoint product/activation trees controlled by the singleton potential Phi.
new_class_or_interface: Arbitrary Boolean products with exactly one shared physical coordinate and otherwise disjoint private blocks.
new_bound: Phi(fg)<=Lambda_x(f)+Lambda_x(g), with coefficient one and no dimension, bias, rank, rarity, or core assumptions.
why_it_matters: It survives the independently reviewed B05 rare-overlap counterfamily by retaining the degree-two coefficients that can shift into singleton mass.
unpaid_parameter: Number and reuse depth of shared coordinates in an adaptive hierarchy.
